x402.description: x402 payment: after receiving the HTTP 402 signed challenge, the wallet signs (EIP-3009) and the request is resubmitted with the payment payload in the X-PAYMENT header. See https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-x402/ for the 4-step flow.

info.description: Cumulative Web Inc's pay-per-call music-industry data APIs on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). No API keys, no accounts: calls carry an X-PAYMENT header per the x402 protocol and settle in USDC. HTTP 402 challenges are live and verifiable today; protocol-mediated settlement is still being proven, so the founding-integrator program is open. Paid routes: $0.05-$0.25 per call. Contact: hp@cumulativeweb.com.
